name: Shy Ground Dove
rangeDescription: Fiji, wallis and futuna islands, tonga, and samoa
description: A rotund, short-legged ground-dwelling dove that usually runs rather than flies when startled. Male has a distinctive dark purple back, wings, and belly, a whitish chest crescent, and a light gray chest and head.

name: Black Thicket-Fantail
rangeDescription: Lowlands of new guinea, including batanta and salawati (raja ampat islands, off western new guinea), and aru islands (off southwestern new guinea)
description: A medium-sized, long-tailed bird of lowland swamp forest and mangroves. Blackish plumage with short white eye-brow, white patch on the side of the throat and prominent white tail tips.

name: Great Crested Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Breeds southeastern canada to gulf states; winters to northwestern south america
description: Fairly large flycatcher of mature forests. Relatively bright and richly colored for a Myiarchus flycatcher; especially note bright yellow belly, grayish throat and breast, and dull pinkish base to the lower mandible.

name: Steller's Sea-Eagle
rangeDescription: Coastal eastern siberia; winters to china, korea, and japan including ryukyu islands (southern japan)
description: An immense eagle with large head and massive orange bill to match. Adult is striking, even from a great distance: rich brown overall, with snow-white tail, belly, and shoulder patches.

name: Berlepsch's Canastero
rangeDescription: Andes of western bolivia (nevado illampu region in la paz)
description: Short-tailed canastero endemic to the Sorata vicinity in northern Bolivia. Prefers montane scrub on hillsides, but occasionally near human development and open Polylepis forest.

name: Yellow-crowned Manakin
rangeDescription: Eastern colombia to southwestern venezuela and northern amazonian brazil
description: Fairly large, distinctive manakin. Males have olive backs and are rusty colored below, contrasting with a white throat.

name: Amur Stonechat
rangeDescription: Eastern siberia to japan and korea; winters to southern china and indochina
description: A chunky little bird found in a wide variety of open landscapes, often sitting on exposed perches. Breeding male has a black head, a broad white half-collar, mostly rusty-red underparts, and a white undertail and rump.

name: White-chested Puffbird
rangeDescription: Southeastern colombia to eastern peru, the guianas, and western amazonian brazil
description: Brown-and-white streaked bird with a large head and yellowish bill; white crescent on chest is helpful for identification but can be difficult to see. Inhabits lower and middle levels of tall rainforest, where it is easily overlooked as it sits motionless for long periods before darting to tree trunks, foliage, or ground for large insect and small vertebrate prey.

name: Buru Bush Warbler
rangeDescription: Buru island (southern moluccas)
description: A sparrow-sized dark warbler with an often scruffy-looking, graduated tail. Has dark chestnut-brown upperparts, a whitish eyebrow, a distinct white throat, and dull grayish underparts.

name: Black-winged Lovebird
rangeDescription: Highland forest of ethiopia
description: A small, short-tailed parrot that is mostly dark green. Males have a red patch above the bill and black underwings that are distinctive in flight.

name: Black-browed Barbet
rangeDescription: Montane forest of malay peninsula and sumatra
description: Loud but sluggish and difficult-to-see canopy inhabitant of highland forests in peninsular Malaysia and Sumatra. Note the leaf-green body, brightly colored face, and heavy black bill.

name: Sri Lanka Blue-Magpie
rangeDescription: Dense evergreen hill forest of sri lanka
description: A large, long-tailed blue bird with a white-tipped tail, and chestnut hood and wings. Inhabits humid forest from lowlands to hills, where it often accompanies mixed canopy flocks, either singly or in small groups.

name: Variable Chachalaca
rangeDescription: Southern venezuela, the guianas, and northern amazonian brazil
description: Slender, long-tailed, chickenlike bird that is often seen in small groups. Grayish-brown overall with a warmer chestnut head.

name: Sulphur-bellied Tyrant-Manakin
rangeDescription: Tropical eastern peru to northern bolivia and adjacent western amazonian brazil
description: Large, tan manakin. Longer-tailed with a more upright posture than other smaller manakins.

name: Booted Warbler
rangeDescription: Breeds eastern palearctic; winters to india and sri lanka
description: Small, recalling a beige chiffchaff or other Phylloscopus warbler. Rather nondescript: gray brown above, paler below, with a short, dark-tipped bill and conspicuous pale eyebrow.

name: Steller's Sea-Eagle
rangeDescription: Coastal eastern siberia; winters to china, korea, and japan including ryukyu islands (southern japan)
description: An immense eagle with large head and massive orange bill to match. Adult is striking, even from a great distance: rich brown overall, with snow-white tail, belly, and shoulder patches.

name: Chestnut-colored Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Gulf-caribbean slope of southern mexico (southern veracruz) to western panama
description: Attractive, medium-sized crested woodpecker of humid tropical lowlands. Uncommon in evergreen forest and edge ranging into adjacent clearings with taller trees.

name: Little Spotted Kiwi
rangeDescription: Kapiti, south, and formerly north islands (new zealand)
description: New Zealand’s smallest kiwi species. Light grayish brown with white horizontal banding or “spotting” along the length of the body.
imageCreditName: Laurie Ross | Tracks Birding & Photography Tours

name: Tiny Tyrant-Manakin
rangeDescription: Southeastern venezuela to the guianas and northeastern amazonian brazil
description: Tiny, short-tailed denizen of tall rainforest; common, but heard far more often than seen. Virtually devoid of good field marks, since male’s yellow crown patch is rarely seen from below.

name: Calliope Hummingbird
rangeDescription: Mountains of british columbia to southwestern usa and northern baja california; winters to southern mexico
description: Tiny, compact hummingbird with short tail. Males are distinctive with streaked magenta throat.
